sync_rule: A file is current only if a remote per-file successful status (processed or skipped_non_study) matches its modified timestamp. Pending or absent records must be retried. Publish notes and this manifest in the same non-forced default-branch commit. Preserve manual edits.
duplicate_comparison: All four sources were inspected page by page. The two printed sheets have 2 pages each; the corresponding handwritten files have 9 and 15 pages, contain distinct answer material, and have separate Markdown destinations. No sources share a source-note destination.

attachment_policy: Do not commit source PDFs, page images, or other binary attachments. Retain Drive source links and page references; represent diagrams faithfully in Markdown/LaTeX where possible, otherwise link the original source and mark limitations. Downloads and rendering are temporary processing artifacts outside the repository.
transcription_policy: Produce clean mathematical notes. Correct obvious typos, variable-name inconsistencies, missing brackets or exponents, and harmless shorthand when the intended meaning is clear from the visually inspected source and mathematical context. Make routine algebra or immediate implicit steps explicit where helpful. Reserve TODOs for substantive mathematical errors, essential logical gaps, genuinely unresolved meaning, or truly unfinished work. Do not invent a new proof or solve an unfinished problem. Keep source traceability and record normalization summaries in the manifest rather than cluttering notes with minor correction flags.
